question.text: If $\vec{r}$ and $\vec{s}$ arenon-zero constant vectors and the scalar $b$ is chosen such that $|\vec{r}+b \vec{s}|$ is minimum, then the value of $|b \vec{s}|^{2}+|\vec{r}+b \vec{s}|^{2}$ is equal to

solution.text:
For minimum value $|\vec{r}+b \vec{s}|=0$. Let $\vec{r}$ and $\vec{s}$ are anti-parallel so $b \vec{s}=-\vec{r}$

$\therefore|b \vec{s}|^{2}+|\vec{r}+b \vec{s}|^{2}=|-\vec{r}|^{2}+|\vec{r}-\vec{r}|^{2}=|\vec{r}|^{2}$
